title: TRACE-CRC: Trajectory-Adaptive Conformal Risk Control for Multi-Step Channel State Information Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.27124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable prediction of time-varying channel state information (CSI) is essential for efficient wireless communication. Each CSI frame is a matrix-valued representation of the wireless channel response, and a sequence of CSI frames forms a temporal channel trajectory. Modern deep learning-based CSI predictors, however, often provide only point predictions and lack calibrated uncertainty estimates. This limitation is particularly problematic in multi-step CSI prediction, where the target is a sequence of future CSI matrices, and downstream decisions such as beamforming or scheduling may fail if any part of the predicted trajectory is unreliable. We propose trajectory-adaptive calibration and error profiling with conformal risk control (TRACE-CRC), a method for trajectory-aware uncertainty quantification in multi-step CSI prediction. translated_title: TRACE-CRC：用于多步信道状态信息预测的轨迹自适应共形风险控制
translated_abstract: 可靠预测时变信道状态信息（CSI）对高效无线通信至关重要。每个CSI帧是无线信道响应的矩阵值表示，而一系列CSI帧形成时间信道轨迹。然而，现代基于深度学习的CSI预测器通常仅提供点预测，缺乏校准的不确定性估计。这一限制在多步CSI预测中尤为突出，因为目标是未来CSI矩阵序列，若预测轨迹的任何部分不可靠，下游决策（如波束成形或调度）可能失败。我们提出轨迹自适应校准和误差剖析与共形风险控制（TRACE-CRC），一种用于多步CSI预测中轨迹感知不确定性量化的方法。TRACE-CRC在预测CSI矩阵周围构建Frobenius范数不确定性球，并控制风险阈值。
tldr: TRACE-CRC通过轨迹自适应校准和共形风险控制，为多步CSI预测提供校准的不确定性估计，确保下游决策的可靠性。
en_tdlr: TRACE-CRC provides calibrated uncertainty estimates for multi-step CSI prediction via trajectory-adaptive calibration and conformal risk control, ensuring reliability of downstream decisions.
